# E-M5 III 1.7 USB webcam (partial port)

Test builds enumerate as a UVC webcam and stream a picture; live view over USB does not work.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** unpublished webcam test builds

Test builds make the camera enumerate as a UVC webcam and stream a camera-generated picture over bulk transfers; streaming real live view failed, so the work is parked.

**Availability:** research. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Limits

- Parked since 2026-10-20.
- Fixing live view needs the camera to stay in shooting mode while USB is connected.
